# 50.00 CAD paid out of the bank to C001, against the receivable.
#
# The receivable split states `lot_owner: customer:C001`, and `lot_guid:` with
# the placeholder LOT_GUID. The test puts the guid of a lot in its place, or
# removes the line so the import looks for C001's credit itself.
#
# What this fixture produces: one CAD transaction, Assets:Bank -50.00 against
# Assets:Accounts Receivable +50.00, the receivable split attributed to C001.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_lot_with_no_owner_has_one_attached_or_is_listed.py.
2026-03-05 * "Paid back to Acme"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank -50.00 CAD
	Assets:Accounts Receivable 50.00 CAD
		lot_owner: customer:C001
		lot_guid: "LOT_GUID"
